title: Tree Modules for Roots of Acyclic Quivers
scope: Every nonzero positive root of every finite acyclic quiver; indecomposable representation with a tree coefficient multigraph.
strongest_verified_result: Finite exact reformulation; explicit real non-Schur tree module of affine D4 dimension (3;2,2,1,1); complete exact support enumerations for four fixed cases.
remaining_gap: Prove uniformly that every positive-root dimension has at least one normalized tree support with local endomorphism algebra, including real and imaginary non-Schur roots not covered by verified constructions.
independent_internal_crosscheck: All 32 Kronecker supports agree with a separate invertible-pencil discriminant test; independent adversarial audit is still pending.
literature_limit: No full resolution located in bounded primary-source check; not an exhaustive literature certification.
publication_scope: Only the author packet; no source PDFs, full texts, datasets, downloaded images, or private coordination files.
